description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 2540015662408 BELT,VEHICULAR SAFE: Line 0001 Qty 24 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0081 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
